=== ARCHITECTURAL COHERENCE ===

Architectural Pattern: ML Logic Delegation to RPC API

Specifications Following This Pattern:
1. thompson-sampling-in-rpc-api-only
2. metrics-calculation-in-rpc-api-only
3. impulse-learning-in-rpc-api-only
4. complete-architecture-separation

Pattern Compliance:
- ✅ metabob-opencode: Execution + coordination (thin client)
- ✅ metabob-rpc-api: ML + metrics + storage (thick server)
- ✅ All ML algorithms in RPC API
- ✅ All data collection in opencode
- ✅ Clean API boundaries

Coherence Status: FULLY COHERENT ✅

=== DEPENDENCY FLOW ANALYSIS ===

Data Flow: opencode → rpc-api

1. Template Selection Flow:
   opencode:TemplateSelector.select()
     → opencode:RpcHttpClient.selectTemplateVariant()
     → rpc-api:POST /v2/activities/templates/{id}/select
     → rpc-api:select_variant_thompson_sampling()
     → rpc-api:sample_beta() [Thompson Sampling]
     → return selected variant with metadata

2. Metrics Collection Flow:
   opencode:Activity.execute()
     → opencode:RpcHttpClient.recordExecution()
     → rpc-api:POST /v2/activities/executions
     → rpc-api:record_execution_result()
     → rpc-api:update_metrics_after_execution()
     → update Thompson parameters (alpha, beta)

3. Learning Loop Flow:
   opencode:ImpulseLearning.recordTurn()
     → opencode:RpcHttpClient.recordTurn()
     → rpc-api:POST /v2/learning/turn
     → rpc-api:normalize_pattern()
     → rpc-api:calculate_quality()
     → store learning data

Dependency Status: CLEAN ✅
- No circular dependencies
- Unidirectional flow (opencode → rpc-api)
- Clear ownership boundaries
